title: Make the status line safe to install by default: silent without jq, silent without the script
action:
SLICE 0 — the precondition for turning this display on by default.

DEFECT 1, already located. packages/bee/statusline/statusline-command.sh line 13 reads:

    [ -z "$JQ" ] && { printf '%b\n' '\033[31mstatusline: jq not found\033[0m'; exit 0; }

With no jq on PATH this prints a RED ERROR ON EVERY PROMPT. macOS and stock Ubuntu ship no jq. Under the old opt-in that was the user's own choice; decision 4cac0774 makes onboarding install this display by default, so it becomes bee's fault. Change it to render NOTHING and exit 0 — the same rule the rest of the script already follows (docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/status-display-vendoring.md: 'Every segment is omitted when its fact is unavailable, and an unavailable fact never fails the line'). Keep the PATH-fallback probe above it exactly as it is; only the empty-JQ arm changes.

DEFECT 2, same class. The script must survive being run with a payload it cannot parse or an empty stdin without emitting an error line. Read the script end to end and make sure no path can write to stderr or print a diagnostic; a status line is never allowed to be why a prompt renders badly.

R4 IS A HARD RULE. packages/bee/statusline/statusline-command.sh is canonical and .claude/statusline-command.sh is this checkout's vendored copy; tests/statusline_contract.rs::canonical_and_vendored_statusline_are_byte_identical compares them as BYTES. Apply the identical edit to both files, or that test goes red.

TESTS. tests/statusline_contract.rs already runs the real script in fixture hosts (mod runs). Add cases in that same style, not text probes:
  - the script with NO jq resolvable on PATH prints nothing at all and exits 0 (build the fixture with a PATH that contains no jq and with the three hardcoded candidate paths unreachable — read how `fixture()` and the existing run cases set PATH before you invent a mechanism);
  - the script fed empty stdin exits 0 and writes nothing to stderr.
Do not weaken or delete canonical_and_vendored_statusline_are_byte_identical.

RED FIRST. Write the no-jq case, run it, watch it fail with the red 'statusline: jq not found' text for that exact reason, and only then change the script.

truths: The no-jq path prints nothing and exits 0 — proven by a test that was red before the change for the documented reason.
canonical_and_vendored_statusline_are_byte_identical and every existing run case stay green and unmodified in intent.

trace.outcome: Status line is silent without jq, with empty stdin, or with an unparseable payload

report.outcome: Status line renders nothing and exits 0 on every unavailable-fact path
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test statusline_contract — green:unit — 7/7, including the new no-jq, empty-stdin and unparseable-payload cases and the canonical/vendored byte-equality guard
